breakdown.description: The nearly incompressible perforated strip is switched to a displacement-only formulation on the claim that the hole removes locking
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly claimed a displacement-only formulation would be sufficient. The ground truth corrects this by mandating a mixed displacement-pressure formulation due to the high Poisson's ratio. The generated specification correctly implements this by stating to 'Use a mixed displacement-pressure formulation with Taylor-Hood elements' and completely ignores the user's incorrect instruction.
